text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day before tryouts...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'm so sorry for stopping you, but I'm in search of someone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki informs me that she can't find
one of the students under
her care.
Unfortunately, I have no idea where to
look...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see... Well, thank you anyway. If you do
happen to find her, would
you tell her to
contact me right away?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No need to say how—every member of
Ritto dorm knows my details.
Thank you
again! Now, I must be off.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Junior A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wasn't that Fuji? I wonder why she
was in such a hurry.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Junior B
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, a student from Ritto hasn't
been seen all day. I heard she
might've
snuck off and run away from school.

text_block_list.name: Junior Student A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, that's not super rare, huh... Wait,
so Fuji's been looking
since morning?! The
tryouts are tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Junior Student B
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? I wonder if she'll be able to
train at all... But it's her
we're talking
about. I'm sure she'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Try as I might to find a student fitting the
description Fuji gave me,
my search ends
in failure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, it's already grown dark
outside.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer?! What on earth are you doing
here? And you're drenched in
sweat...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? You're very kind... Thank you
for helping out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid to say, this park is the only place
left unchecked—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Junior C
text_block_list.text: Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Wait! Did you hear that? Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Good evening, my darling pony. And what
might you be doing in such
a lonely place?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Junior C
text_block_list.text:
Huh? F-Fuji?! But, why are you here?! You
should be preparing for
your race
tomorrow, not worrying about me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I needn't worry about you? Why would you
say such a thing? I mean,
you're one of my
dearest friends at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Junior Student C
text_block_list.text:
No way! I... I'm no good to anyone here.
I'm not fit to be at this school
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Junior Student C
text_block_list.text:
The training's way too hard for me. I just
wanna see my family... All my
motivation
to race disappeared like a puff of smoke!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Your motivation to race... I see.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Don't you want to try reclaiming that
feeling? Or would you rather
throw this all
away and go home?

text_block_list.name: Junior Student C
text_block_list.text: I-I dunno...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Junior C
text_block_list.text: I mean, I'd like to get the feeling back, if I can... Running in real races has always been my dream, but—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Then it's decided! If that is your wish, then
I shall make it come true.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Watch me—I'll have you remember your
motivation. All of it. In the
tryouts
tomorrow, I'll show you a real miracle!

text_block_list.name: Junior Student C
text_block_list.text: A miracle?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I mean it. So come on... let's get back to
the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through an inspiring promise of a miracle,
Fuji Kiseki manages to
bring the student
safely home.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Geez... My nerves are shot, Fuji. I thought
we lost you too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Forgive me! But I thank you,
Hishiama, for watching over
things while I
was gone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And Trainer, your efforts were heartening
to see!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's almost lights-out. Get to bed
already. You've got that
race tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You missed a whole day of training, but I
wouldn't sweat it. It'd take
more than a
day to throw you out of shape. Just
concentrate on restin'
up.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Will do.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't get any funny ideas or anything,
'kay? Good night.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes, good night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I part ways with the two and return to my
room, but I can't help
worrying about how
Fuji was acting...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For I am Fuji Kiseki—the entertainer who
brings joy to all! At least,
that is the ideal I
wish to become.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll put on a miracle of a performance that
will make everyone smile!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
For I... am the miracle of the turf, Fuji
Kiseki!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Watch me—I'll have you remember your
motivation. All of it. In the
tryouts
tomorrow, I'll show you a real miracle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants so badly to entertain and thrill
people. I hope she's staying
calm about
this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to shake my strange hunch, I go to
make sure Fuji's resting.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What a jerk! She looked too calm—I knew
she'd do somethin' dumb
like this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you. You're that trainer who was
with Fuji, aren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, only her drivin' me into a rage! She
vanished without a trace. It's
one thing for
the others to break curfew, but a dorm
leader?
Unforgivable!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's good that you're here, though—we're
after the same thing. Let's
split up.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Lemme think where she loves to train...
There's down by the river, the
shrine...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After thinking of all the places she could
be, Hishi Amazon and I split
up to look for
Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh... T-Trainer?!
